Clarity & Hierarchy: Score is duplicated and inconsistent — top boxes show SCORE 00008 / BEST 00008 while the in-scene top-right shows 'HI 00008 / 00008 pts', so the player can't tell which is canonical; the jump pill floats in the middle of the run lane where obstacles would travel, blocking the play space it's meant to explain; the dino is small and low-contrast, so the eye goes to the oversized sun instead of the character; the footer legend explains icons that don't appear in the scene, reading as a spec sheet. Visual System & Craft: A white cloud blob overlaps the sun disc, breaking its silhouette and reading as a z-order mistake; ground dashes are randomly scattered rather than a rhythmic grid, undermining the 'rhythmic spacing' goal; the dino's silhouette has a flat triangular tail notch and static rectangular legs that reduce crispness at its small scale; border weights are slightly inconsistent (double border on the play area vs single on the header boxes); the heavy drop shadow on the jump pill feels out of place with the flat retro system.
